description: Land Acquisition - Bendiyamulla, Kidagammulla, Henarathgoda, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations about specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including extensive descriptions of land boundaries, lot numbers, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando) in an official capacity, the core content is exclusively about land acquisition and property matters, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
